payload.title: Opening-screen insider terms
payload.description:
As a publication operator, I want product or trade terms the reader has not been given flagged in the opening paragraph unless the sentence defines them, so the first screen reads for a general reader.

Feature: Opening screen
  Scenario: An undefined insider term in the opening paragraph is flagged
    Given a profile whose opening insiderTerms include "decision model"
    And a draft whose first paragraph uses "decision model" without defining it
    When I diagnose it
    Then diagnosis reports an opening-screen finding for "decision model"
  Scenario: A term defined in the same sentence is not flagged
  Scenario: The same term later in the body is not flagged
  Scenario: Imports, figures, and headings before the first paragraph are skipped
